title: Victoria Butterfly Gardens Ticket
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Children must be accompanied by an adult
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Step into the tropics at Victoria Butterfly Gardens, a indoor tropical jungle experience. Spanning 12,000 square feet and open year-round, the Gardens offer a warm, lush escape where thousands of butterflies from over 75 species flutter freely among 200+ tropical plant varieties. Beyond butterflies, visitors can meet a colorful cast of rescued residents - from Mango the flamingo, to macaws, parrots, iguanas, turtles, and even a dwarf caiman. Every animal has been rescued or rehomed, finding a safe, permanent home in this vibrant ecosystem. Before entering the jungle, explore the Insectarium, a fascinating world of leaf-cutter ants, giant stick insects, and more. The Gardens offer an accessible, educational, and unforgettable experience, rain or shine.
Open 364 days a year, except for Christmas Day.
